label: nyiso 19 locational reserve
definition: (PROBE) Fix #3: in-LP LOCATIONAL reserve co-optimization for NYISO (NYCA-system plus nested East/SENY/NYC RCPF families, FERC ER21-502 / RS4 anchors), on top of the LI self-supply + firm-import floors (--energy-reserve-coopt --nyiso-local-selfsupply --nyiso-firm-imports). Holding the import-constrained downstate pocket to its locational reserve recovers the summer scarcity tail the NYCA-aggregate curve and the post-solve RCPF adder cannot dispatch: reserve fires only in genuine summer scarcity (Jul/Aug/Sep), 2025 summer under-bias eased (Jun -30.7->-14.6, Jul -22.1->-15.8 vs the LI-floor probe), 2025 price_shape now PASSES (NRMSE 0.16) and 2024 price fully PASSES, dispatch r 0.81-0.87 all years. NOT a keeper: the aggregate is gated by a PRE-EXISTING winter/January downstate over-pricing (2023 price_mean +13%, shape 0.402) that a BASE-vs-COOPT A/B proved is identical with the co-opt off (a gas/dual-fuel marginal-unit residual, the next root cause) -- so it does not beat keeper nyiso-11. Per rule #1 the mechanism stays (default OFF).
